title: Build Order
prompt:
There are n tasks labeled 0 to n-1. You are given a list of dependencies, where each dependency [a, b] means task b must be finished before task a can start. Return a list containing all n tasks in an order that respects every dependency. If no such order exists (the dependencies contain a cycle), return an empty list.

Any valid order is accepted.

Example:
  build_order(4, [[1, 0], [2, 0], [3, 1], [3, 2]]) -> [0, 1, 2, 3]   (or [0, 2, 1, 3])
  build_order(2, [[0, 1], [1, 0]]) -> []
